about_the_game:
The key to that old shop from your grandfather is now in your hands. Open the door, accompanied by the familiar scent of wood and memories drifting from inside. It might be a little dusty, a little forgotten, but now, it's your home.

Cafe Hub Together is a warm and sincere cafe management game where four siblings come together to revive a dream. You're not here to build a massive business empire. Your goal is to honor your grandfather's legacy and turn this small shop into the coziest, most heartfelt corner of the town.

Turn this dream into reality with your siblings. While one works wonders at the coffee machine, another can greet customers with the smell of freshly baked cookies from the oven. Decide together which painting to hang on the wall, add delicious desserts to the menu, and greet every face that walks through the door with a friendly smile.

Because this isn't just a shop; it's your freshly brewed story. So put on your apron and get behind the counter. The first page is waiting for you.

GAME FEATURES:

In Cafe Hub Together, not just a heartwarming story awaits you, but also a cafe full of features you can enjoy managing with your friends:

  • Up to 4-Player Co-op Gameplay: Join forces with your friends! While one becomes a master barista, another can manage the cash register or create delicious desserts in the kitchen. Teamwork is the key to this cafe.

  • Customize and Decorate Your Cafe: Create your cafe from scratch with dozens of furniture items, wallpapers, and decorative objects. You decide where everything goes and create the coziest atmosphere for your customers.

  • Interactive Drink and Food Preparation: Bring various recipes to life with different coffee beans, syrups, and milks. Unlock special recipes to enrich your menu with unique flavors.

  • Grow and Develop Your Cafe: Use the money you earn to buy new and better coffee machines, kitchen equipment, and decorations. Level up your cafe to unlock new recipes and features.

  • Customer Relations and Town Life: Every customer who visits your cafe has their own unique story and order. Win their satisfaction by preparing their orders correctly and quickly, and become the most beloved spot in town.
